item.description:
First standalone release of Poppy MagicBox for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 27 or later.
- See CPU, memory, network, and disk activity in the menu bar and Top Panel. - Review up to an hour of recent activity in Monitor History, or open Disk Space to explore what is using storage. - See resident RAM by running app in the Memory panel. - Use **Check for Updates…** in the Poppy MagicBox menu to get future standalone releases.
Open the DMG, drag Poppy MagicBox to Applications, then open it from Applications. If you already have a standalone build without automatic update support, install this DMG once to receive future updates through Sparkle.
